summary: M consumes cfm.commerce2.market-slug-redirects/1 and is deployed BEFORE any canary URL changes. No map has been delivered yet, so no redirect can fire: all 33 public canary URLs still serve themselves. Foreign markets stay noindex and unsellable; Slovakia is unchanged.

delivery.file: MAKY_MARKET_SLUG_REDIRECTS_PATH (a file beside the other artifacts, outside the git tree)
delivery.checksum: MAKY_MARKET_SLUG_REDIRECTS_SHA256 — M verifies the delivered bytes and refuses the map on a mismatch

consumes.identity: map cfm_product_id ↔ Saleor externalReference (cfm:product: prefix and case ignored); 500/500 sampled cohort products carry one
rules: no redirect until the new slug resolves in that market AND belongs to the same product — the old URL keeps serving until CFM swaps it
one permanent 301; chains flattened at load; cycles, over-long chains, ambiguous old slugs and cross-product chains dropped
the retired /{market}/products/{slug} form lands on the final URL in one hop
reserved market routes (cart word, search, products, localized category root, legal pages) are never treated as product slugs
Slovakia is untouched; SK and EN_US entries are dropped and counted

previewCanaryEvidence.serving: 33/33 return 200 at their CURRENT url, canonical on themselves, x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow, price in the channel currency (AT EUR, CA CAD)
previewCanaryEvidence.note: These are today's OLD slugs. The same evidence will be re-taken on the NEW slugs, with the new CFM read-back, after the swap.

localizedSitemap.state: deployed; only sk is live, so production still publishes 3 sk shards and 11 079 URLs
localizedSitemap.verifiedAgainstLiveSaleor: local run of this build with MAKY_LIVE_MARKETS=sk,at against the real API: /sitemaps/at-products-1.xml carries exactly the 3 published canary products with their DE_AT slugs and no Slovak base slug; /sitemaps/at-pages-1.xml carries /at/dachtraeger and /at/categories/nordrive-dachtraeger; sk-products-1 unchanged at 9 571
localizedSitemap.rule: a foreign shard lists only what that market can render — the exact-locale boundary decides, for products and for categories

production.foreignRobots: x-robots-tag: noindex, nofollow on every foreign URL checked
production.foreignPurchasing: off — the 3 canary products per foreign channel are visible, nothing else; Stripe, SMTP, shipping and taxes untouched
production.smokeVsPreviousDeploy: 16 URLs x 12 fields: 6 differences, all on foreign category pages and all caused by CFM publishing the canary (the page stopped being empty, so it gained a canonical and its body meta says index) — the binding x-robots-tag noindex is unchanged

waitingFor.map: MARKET_SLUG_REDIRECTS with the REAL old slugs from today's Saleor — the 33 public canary combinations above must be covered if their slug changes
waitingFor.then: M verifies sha256, points the env at the file, restarts, and announces readiness. Only then should CFM swap the canary slugs in Saleor.
